'''Thaereian Security Facility Number 12''' was a security facility that was located in [[Gadrin]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
The facility was run by the [[Gadrin]] branch of the [[Office of Peace and Security]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, during the conflict it was taken over by the [[Thaereian military]] and [[Elis' Gan]] was made the facility's commandant. A military force called [[Task Force Pest]] was established to arrest [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dalin]] they took their prisoners to the security facility, where [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-blocking drugs were tested on them. However the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who had been hired by the [[Cularin Militia]], were able to infiltrate the facility and free some of the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].
